% v3-figures/transparency.tex: the log, the monitor, the witnesses, the gossip pool and the
% equivocation proof. Everything the log publishes leaves its signed head along one vertical
% trunk, which branches straight to the monitor, the three witnesses and the external ledger;
% nothing crosses. Generated by tools/figures_en.py.
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  col/.style={minimum width=3.4cm, text width=3.1cm},
  wit/.style={extbox, minimum width=2.6cm, minimum height=0.62cm},
]
\node[layerbox, col] (log) at (0,4.3) {The log\\[-1pt]{\mdseries\scriptsize an append-only table of roots (anchor batches, receipt hashes, or anchored timestamps), hashed into a Merkle tree}};
\node[softbox, col] (sth) at (0,0.85) {Signed tree head\\[-1pt]{\scriptsize log id, tree size, root hash, time; signed by the log's key}};
\node[softbox, col] (proofs) at (0,-2.7) {Proofs\\[-1pt]{\scriptsize consistency: size $m$ is a prefix of size $n$; inclusion: entry $i$ is in the tree}};
\draw[flow] (log) -- (sth);
\draw[flowfaint] (sth) -- (proofs);
\node[extbox, minimum width=3.6cm, text width=3.3cm] (mon) at (8.20,4.85) {Monitor\\[-1pt]{\scriptsize anyone runs it; keeps one thing: the last head it accepted. Alerts on a rewrite, a fork, a shrink, a wrong key, time going backwards.}\\[2pt]{\scriptsize\bfseries\color{classmark}cannot see whether another observer was shown a different head}};
\node[wit] (w1) at (8.20,1.6) {witness 1};
\node[wit] (w2) at (8.20,0.85) {witness 2};
\node[wit] (w3) at (8.20,0.1) {witness 3};
\node[extbox, minimum width=3.6cm, text width=3.3cm] (ledger) at (8.20,-2.95) {External ledger\\[-1pt]{\scriptsize an append-only log of heads; returns a receipt with its own head and an inclusion proof (file backend today; chain drivers declared)}};
\draw[flow, -] (sth.east) -- (3.70,0.85);
\draw[navymid, line width=1pt] (3.70,4.85) -- (3.70,-2.95);
\draw[flow] (3.70,4.85) -- (mon.west);
\draw[flow] (3.70,1.6) -- (w1.west);
\draw[flow] (3.70,0.85) -- (w2.west);
\draw[flow] (3.70,0.1) -- (w3.west);
\draw[flow] (3.70,-2.95) -- (ledger.west);
\node[faint, anchor=south, text width=2.6cm, align=center] at (5.05,4.9) {head + consistency proof};
\node[faint, anchor=south, text width=2.6cm, align=center] at (5.05,-2.9) {publishes each head};
\node[softbox, minimum width=3.3cm, text width=3.1cm] (cosig) at (12.90,2.35) {cosignatures\\[-1pt]{\scriptsize a relying party requires $K$ distinct trusted witnesses on the exact head}};
\node[softbox, minimum width=3.3cm, text width=3.1cm] (pool) at (12.90,-0.85) {gossip pool\\[-1pt]{\scriptsize each witness posts the head it was shown}};
\node[corebox, minimum width=3.4cm, text width=3.2cm] (eq) at (12.90,-4.35) {equivocation proof\\[-1pt]{\mdseries\scriptsize two heads, same size, different roots, both signed by the log: non-repudiable}};
\foreach \w in {w1,w2,w3} { \draw[flow] (\w.east) -- (cosig.west); }
\draw[flowfaint, dash pattern=on 3pt off 2pt] (w3.east) -- (pool.west);
\draw[flow] (pool) -- (eq);
\node[faint, text width=15cm, align=center, anchor=north] at (5.60,-6.2) {The protocol for independent witnesses is built and drilled under real signatures. Institutionally independent witnesses, a bank, a civil-society group, another authority, exist only once the system is deployed; today the witnesses are three processes in a drill.};
\end{tikzpicture}
